stefan-boltzmann-total-a323e6aa.title: Stefan-Boltzmann Law
stefan-boltzmann-total-a323e6aa.interpretation: Defines the total power radiated by a blackbody as proportional to the fourth power of its temperature.
stefan-boltzmann-total-a323e6aa.symmetry_origin: The integral of the spectral energy density over all allowed frequencies.
stefan-boltzmann-total-a323e6aa.limits_and_boundary: Calculates the total luminosity of thermodynamic systems and stars.

higgs-field-potential-energy-e64fcc7a.title: The Higgs Potential (Mexican Hat)
higgs-field-potential-energy-e64fcc7a.interpretation: Characterizes the energy density of the Higgs field, where the negative quadratic term triggers the instability that leads to a non-zero vacuum state.
higgs-field-potential-energy-e64fcc7a.symmetry_origin: The (2)_L 	imes U(1)_Y$ invariant scalar sector of the electroweak Lagrangian.
higgs-field-potential-energy-e64fcc7a.limits_and_boundary: The parameters $\mu^2$ and $\lambda$ must be positive to ensure the existence of a stable minimum at a non-zero field strength.

yukawa-interaction-matrix-lagrangian-1a9.title: Yukawa Matrix Interaction
yukawa-interaction-matrix-lagrangian-1a9.interpretation: Characterizes the gauge-invariant coupling between chiral fermion doublets and singlets through the scalar Higgs field, where {ij}$ is the Yukawa coupling matrix in generation space.
yukawa-interaction-matrix-lagrangian-1a9.symmetry_origin: The requirement for (2)_L 	imes U(1)_Y$ invariance in a theory with non-trivial generational structure.
yukawa-interaction-matrix-lagrangian-1a9.limits_and_boundary: The misalignment of these matrices relative to the gauge basis is the source of all flavor-mixing phenomena.

gluon-field-strength-tensor-non-abelian-.title: Gluon Field Strength Tensor
gluon-field-strength-tensor-non-abelian-.interpretation: Defines the non-linear curvature of the color field, where the quadratic term in the gluon potentials represents the self-interaction of the gauge fields.
gluon-field-strength-tensor-non-abelian-.symmetry_origin: The requirement for $SU(3)_c$ local gauge invariance in a non-Abelian symmetry group.
gluon-field-strength-tensor-non-abelian-.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to the linear Maxwell field strength as the structure constants $f^{abc} \to 0$.

s-matrix-unitarity-ident-5f7b97bb.title: S-Matrix Unitarity
s-matrix-unitarity-ident-5f7b97bb.interpretation: Asserts that the total probability of all possible scattering outcomes is identically equal to unity, ensuring the conservation of information and probability in particle interactions.
s-matrix-unitarity-ident-5f7b97bb.symmetry_origin: The unitary time-evolution of the quantum state in a Hilbert space manifold.
s-matrix-unitarity-ident-5f7b97bb.limits_and_boundary: Essential for the consistency of quantum field theories; any violation would signal the leakage of information into unobserved degrees of freedom.

nuclear-eos-identity-1-32e25465.title: Nuclear Pressure Equation of State
nuclear-eos-identity-1-32e25465.interpretation: Formulates the thermodynamic pressure of dense baryonic matter in terms of its energy per baryon and number density.
nuclear-eos-identity-1-32e25465.symmetry_origin: First law of thermodynamics applied to a uniform baryon fluid.
nuclear-eos-identity-1-32e25465.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to classical Newtonian ideal gas pressure as the baryon density approaches zero.

dark-matter-halos-identity-1-f7170e8c.title: Friedmann Equation for Cosmic Expansion
dark-matter-halos-identity-1-f7170e8c.interpretation: Governs the rate of spatial expansion of the universe under the influence of the gravitational constant G, cosmic curvature k, energy density rho, and the cosmological constant Lambda.
dark-matter-halos-identity-1-f7170e8c.symmetry_origin: Einstein field equations under homogeneous and isotropic Friedmann-Lemaitre-Robertson-Walker (FLRW) spatial metrics.
dark-matter-halos-identity-1-f7170e8c.limits_and_boundary: Reduces to flat Euclidean spatial scaling as the scale factor goes to a constant value and expansion velocity approaches zero.
